title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1135)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1135 Date: November 9, 2026 As of November 4, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: IBM MQ Prior to or equal to 10.0.0.5 LTS and CD Prior to or equal to 9.2.0.44 LTS Prior to or equal to 9.3.0.42 LTS Prior to or equal to 9.4.0.26 LTS Prior to or equal to 9.4.5.1 CD IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge Prior to or equal to 5.4.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security Bulletin: IBM MQ Managed File Transfer is affected by an arbitrary code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-11724) Security Bulletin: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to a D.O.S. in Unpacker. (CVE-2026-17493) IBM Product Security Incident Response Article Link: IBM security advisory (AV26-1135) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
